mostWorthwhile.text: Testing the rover and seeing a curve reveal unequal motor speeds was worthwhile: it connected a visible problem to a practical adjustment.

leastWorthwhile.text: Clipping and fitting the pen were necessary but predictable preparations, with little to decide.

surprise.text: The straight-line test made it clear how changing one wheel’s speed turns the rover into a loop.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though the single-option menu made the sequence feel prescribed rather than discovered.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the drawing tests made the rover’s mechanism understandable, and the whale gave the construction a useful, playful outcome.
